steps.text: The ending note settles. Sakiko's hand lingers on the keyboard.
Faint echoes of music reverberate on through the empty castle halls.
Saki... chan...?
From beside comes a voice long unheard, yet one she could not know any more intimately. She slowly lifts her head.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We finally... finally...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: ...We finally got to meet, Saki-chan.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: It feels like I had this long, long dream... and I was this close to never waking up.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Saki-chan, we've been going in circles for so long. We almost missed each other again.
And before Sakiko stands not just Uika, but her entire band.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: It was like someone gave me a pull, and then I just showed up here.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Blehhh! Why are we being so serious?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: But Saki, you're smiling so happily.
Sakiko has to squint beneath the bright spotlight hanging above. Everything before her feels so unreal, so dreamlike.
But she knows, she knows—
Once more, they have played the music that belongs to them.
The girls of Ave{@nbs}Mujica have finally come back.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yes! Of course I am, I'm so happy...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Uika... Mutsumi.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Nyamu... Umiri.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I missed you... I missed you so badly.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: All of you—welcome back.

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Struggling chirping)

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I'm guessing these things put us to sleep?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: The dreams... they're not working...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You can't leave... you have to... stay here!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Piercing screech)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: —Watch out!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Wolff!!

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Morpheus, cut your losses!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Don't you lecture me with words you cribbed from a storybook!

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Sakiko, take them and—argh!
Before Wolff can finish, an army of threads skewers through its arms, expelling the cotton within.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Oh, crap! Up there—
Countless Corettons circle above, weaving a massive dreamcatcher.
It begins to press in towards the girls, growing ever larger and larger.

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Morpheus... see the error of your ways!
A huge pair of scissors falls from the sky, shredding the dream web into naught but tiny wisps of silk that drift in the air.

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Panicked screech)

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Who was that?!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Nngh—!
The girl gives a few twitches in midair before plummeting to the ground, faster and faster—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Are... are we safe now?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: What in the world is happening...?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Apologies for our lateness.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: M-Miss Iris! We owe a debt to you for your aid... Thank you.
Sakiko is overcome with relief at seeing the familiar fairy. Her exhaustion swiftly catches up, and she feels the strength drain from her as she collapses.
A dull thud echoes through the hall.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Saki-chaaaan!
Sakiko... Sakiko...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Who is it... now...)
Bit by bit, Sakiko regains consciousness, and is greeted by a faint fragrance.
Her eyes flutter open, and she finds herself lying on a soft velvet sofa, a brown-haired girl sitting by her side.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Ah. Have you come to?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You fainted. Going through dreamland after dreamland like that takes a toll on the body.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Though I'd say it's quite incredible you lasted that long despite never encountering such Originium Arts before.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Are the others...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: You needn't fret, I've arranged rooms for them. Bena is with them right now.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Oh, I don't believe I've introduced myself—I am Iris, the present Master of the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We've seen plenty of each other in my dreams... If this is our first time meeting, then who were you before?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Well, as Morpheus demonstrated for you—some fairies of the Castle of Dreams possess the rare Arts to spin dreams.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That said, it's no omnipotent thing. What dreams a caster spins are ultimately limited by their own knowledge of the target.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Morpheus didn't understand you, nor did she regard you as an equal adversary. That is why the dream she spun was so flawed.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: As for why you met me, I would suppose... that was Grandmother's work.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Grandmother?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Yes. The Castle of Dreams's previous Master. She spends all her time in a secluded room to convalesce now, owing to her frail health.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: She gave me this necklace, you see, and over the last few days, it had been terribly temperamental with its energies. Bena and I scrambled to return just in case something was amiss... What a terrible turn of affairs we found.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Kind Old Lady
steps.text: Something just started up over there. You're not safe alone. Go the long way round, quick.

steps.name: Behatted Girl
steps.text: ...Thank you for the warning.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I heard from an old woman nearby...

steps.name: Kind Townsperson
steps.text: You should hurry home.

steps.name: Florist Lady
steps.text: The nights are dark here. Now don't you get lost again.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Miss Sakiko. As the Master of the Castle of Dreams, I beg your forgiveness for all that's transpired.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I suppose you could hardly pardon Morpheus, after all she's done...?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Actually... By all rights I should hate her, but I don't feel that way at all.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: She was quite right, actually. Ave{@nbs}Mujica as a group was never very tightly-knit.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: When I made that initial bet with her, it was solely because I wanted the band members back. It was an act of rash judgment.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: But after entering their dreams only to be rejected by each of them in turn, it finally dawned on me that I hadn't a clue how they felt inside.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Within the dreams she'd spun, we tried to hide our weakest, most fragile parts beneath a beautiful facade.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yet did I ever attempt to know my companions, with whom I'd spent so many days and nights?

spans.text: Yet did I ever attempt to
my companions, with whom I'd spent so many days and nights?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Had I truly resolved to bear the weight of their lives?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: As I fell through the abyss of Limbo, these were the questions I asked myself in infinitude.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Miss Sakiko...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: But when I finally straightened out my heart, awakened my companions, and stood once again before Morpheus, it wasn't just anger I felt...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: It was also a deep, deep sorrow.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In that moment, we looked each other in the eyes. It hit me. My power was frail no longer; I had my friends by my side.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: While she stood by herself, alone as ever, with naught but creations that bent to her will and whim.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: She was the dreamspinner. She knew better than all of us how nothing in the land of dreams was real.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: And yet she still chose to lose herself in such dreams. Surely, she must have had her reasons?
Hah-hahahahah-hah! You're a heartless monster!
No wonder your parents don't want you!
You'll never live through the winter!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: No! You're lying!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Get lost, all of you!!
Uh-oh—run!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Morpheus, are you alright?!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, Iris, is it—is it true what they said?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: They're naughty children, right? The fairies won't bring sweet dreams to them, right?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I'm not a heartless monster, and my parents didn't abandon me, and I can live through the winter, right?!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Morpheus...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, Iris, answer me!!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: There are reasons that Morpheus cannot live outside the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: There is no storybook beauty in these lands. What Morpheus had to endure left her unable to place her trust in the sweet dreams of fairytales.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And I know full well that the Castle's sweet dreams hardly solve every problem...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: 'In the face of reality, what we can accomplish is so very limited.'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: 'It is but one thing. We nestle a seed deep in the depths of a child's heart.'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: 'Likely, it is what they considered the most important event, or thing, to them as children.'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: 'It usually lies quietly deep within. But at crucial moments—when people are at their weakest—it gives them strength.'

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: These words...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Are the very words you spoke to me in my dream, Miss Iris. Now, I offer these same words back to you.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I venture that perhaps, Morpheus is awaiting a dream that lets her become 'grown-up', once and for all.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: As the moon rises, the doll takes on life—see, have the moons not risen?
Iris looks outside. Pale and gentle moonlight shines down on the two of them through the castle window.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Yes. You're right.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Furthermore, Miss Iris, I do have a request...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Pray tell. I'll do what's in my power.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: The five of us have awakened from our dreams, but we don't seem to have returned to our own world...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Being the Master of the Castle of Dreams, I was wondering if you might know a method by which we can go back?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I happened to hear them describe this 'world' of yours while you were unconscious. From what I could gather, it certainly doesn't sound like any city on Terra.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But I've never happened across a case like yours before, and a full trawl of the Castle's archives turned up nothing either.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I intend to contact Rhodes Island—the Doctor there is quite learned, and should know a way to send you back.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Rhodes Island... the pharmaceutical company?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Indeed. You dreamt of it?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yes. I'd be keen on visiting again, and I have some 'old friends' I'd like to meet while I'm... um...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I... I'm starting to forget what they looked like.
Iris gently takes Sakiko's hand, as though anticipating her confusion.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Miss Sakiko. You've been through so many people's dreams. I'm sure you know the Castle's rules through and through by now.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: As with all dreams, the memories will begin to blur and fade from the moment you wake up.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Someday or other, you'll return to your 'world', and when you do, you'll forget about me, about the Castle's sweet dreams, about Terra itself.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: How could I...!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But what happens here will not simply be for naught.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Perhaps you and your friends will have to confront those recurring problems when you go back... but I trust you'll prevail.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Even if you forget everything that happened here, you'll remember the courage you showed in times of hardship.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yes. I trust we will too...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: And when we return to our own world, Ave{@nbs}Mujica will remain together as Ave{@nbs}Mujica.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And I, Master of the Castle of Dreams, will forever remember you as you are now, as 'children'.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Perhaps I'll show up again one day, when you're all grown up—and when I do, I hope you and your friends will still be writing the story of your lives through music.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We have a promise!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What is that noise outside the door...?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We don't have another troublemaker, do we?!
Sakiko hurries to open the door.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Saki-chan—you're awake! Are you feeling okay?

steps.name: Bumbling Corettons
steps.text: (Half-conscious chirping)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Erm, I'm fine... Can you explain what all the noise out here is about?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: We're setting up a new stage, and Miss Bena's making Morpheus use these little creatures to carry stuff around...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: A new stage?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Yeah. Who knows how long we'll be here for. Might as well rehearse while we've got the chance.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: There are so many songs I still want to work on.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Morpheus wanted to build the stage in a dream, but we and Miss Bena unanimously shot that down.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Yeah, I'll pass on dreams for the next while...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Agreed...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Won't somebody show me a smidge of concern? Why am I being given hard labor?!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Angry chirping)
Bena, accompanying Morpheus, offers no words, instead simply giving one of Morpheus' fluffy ears a nice hard flick.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Ahkh—ow-ow-ow!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Pained chirping)

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: You did the crime, now you do the time, Morpheus...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, you're in this with me, Wolff! Go fit that last light!

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: I... alright.
Wolff places its hands on the ground, and in a snap, transforms before everyone's eyes into a bestial shape.
With the light's power cord held gently in its jaws, it leaps up to the top shelf, and effortlessly drapes it over.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Well? How's that for a new stage?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: It's so pretty—!
Nyamu giddily leaps onstage and darts around set after elaborate set.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Humph. Hardly a challenge for me.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Are you forgetting the most important part? The instruments!

spans.text: Are you forgetting the most important part?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Ighk—stop—flicking my ears, I'll bring them out now!
Each instrument appears on stage while Morpheus is still shielding her ears, and the band takes their places.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Mm. Still feels good in the hands.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: (Here's hoping that dream-long blank I had didn't screw up my muscle memory—)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Sakiko, we're all ready. Come on.
Sakiko looks up to see her companions on stage, the spotlight shining on each one of them, as well as a familiar keyboard that seems to call for her return.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I look forward to your performance, Miss Sakiko.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: We missed out on seeing the whole thing last time! Now we can make up for that.

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Joyful chirping)

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Getting to attend your performance, not as an enemy, but as a friend, makes me happier than anything.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, you people are such goody-two-shoes!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: A—Anyhow... I'll be listening closely.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Pft... hahahaha...!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Wh-What are you laughing at? Don't think you can walk all over me just because Iris and Bena are here...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No, nothing... haha! I'm coming now.
Sakiko takes her bandmates' hands, and steps onto the stage of Ave{@nbs}Mujica.
Much as when the last piece of a puzzle falls in place, the picture comes as no particular surprise, but it is the very moment when everything becomes whole again.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Everyone! Upon this land, we shall leave our sound!
In the moonlight, the doll takes on a temporal life.
Beneath their marionette forms, the girls' secrets lie.
Love. Fear. Sorrow. Death. Oblivion.
In a castle of dreams, secrets and sins join together and come alive once more.
Raise your candle high. Be brave through the thorns. Part this fog.
Here, a new fairytale is born.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: This is the wondrous adventure story of us, the dolls.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Welcome... to the world of Ave{@nbs}Mujica.
